title: Find the boundary
label: Sweep to x
steps: Solve x(3−x)=0 to locate the intersections 0 and 3.
note: Correction: the source uses −3 to 3 and obtains −18. The enclosed region instead lies on [0,3].

title: Fill the space
label: Sweep to x
note: The evaluated area extends the recorded setup.

title: Turn the slice
label: Sweep to y
note: A horizontal slice changes the integration variable without changing the idea of area.

title: Rotate a region
label: Cross-section at x
steps: The curves meet at x=1 in the first quadrant.
Washer area is π(R²−r²); outer/inner radii swap at x=1.
Integrate separately on [0,1] and [1,2] to obtain 42π.
note: The reconstruction follows the source split setup. Volume is 42π cubic units.

title: Build with shells
label: Shell at x
steps: The positive region lies between roots x=2 and x=4.
note: The strip rotates into a shell; the schematic exaggerates thickness.

title: Trade one integral
label: Choose x
steps: Set u=x and dv=csc²x dx. Then du=dx and v=−cot x.
F=−x cot x+ln|sin x|+C; differentiate to check.
note: The source begins the setup; the replay supplies a checked antiderivative.

title: Reduce the power
label: Choose x
steps: Set u=x² and dv=sin x dx.
Apply parts again to the remaining ∫2x cos x dx.
note: Differentiating the result gives x² sin x.

title: Split the fraction
label: Choose x
steps: Clearing denominators gives A=−2, B=−1, C=1.
note: Correction: recorded coefficients (−1,−1,−2) fail to reconstruct the numerator. Use (−2,−1,1); x≠1/3,1.

title: Substitute, then integrate
label: Upper angle
steps: Let u=cos x; du=−sin x dx.
An antiderivative is −cos x ln(cos x)+cos x.
note: Correction: the recorded final expression loses a term. This definite integral is negative.

title: Unfold a radical
label: Angle θ
steps: The transformed integrand is sin²θ cos²θ/343.
note: Correction: the displayed secant trial does not suit √(1−49x²). Use the sine substitution on the stated real branch.

title: Revisit the method
label: Choose x
steps: Use parts on 2∫u sin u du.
note: Correction: the source final line has coefficient 1 on sin√x; it must be 2.

title: Push the horizon
label: Finite horizon b
steps: The finite integral equals ln(ln b).
As b→∞, ln(ln b)→∞, so the integral diverges.
note: The finite plot illustrates the proof; a finite window alone does not prove divergence.

title: Measure a curve
label: Trace to y
note: The replay adds a numerical evaluation to the source arc-length setup.

title: Trace with time
formula: x = 3 sin t − 1  |  y = cos t / 2
label: Parameter t
steps: The center is (−1,0); semiaxes are 3 and 1/2.
dy/dx=−tan t/6 where cos t≠0. At t=π, the point is (−1,−1/2).
note: Correction: the source table gives x=0 at t=π. The correct x-coordinate is −1.

title: Let the curve grow
formula: x = eᵗ sin t  |  y = eᵗ cos t
label: Parameter t
steps: Combine their squared derivatives: speed=√2 eᵗ.
note: The axes rescale as the radius grows; the moving point shows the trace.

title: Meet in polar space
formula: r = 3 cos θ  |  r = 1 + cos θ
label: Ray angle θ
steps: The non-origin intersections have θ=±π/3 and r=3/2.
note: The two non-origin intersections are highlighted on the reconstructed curves.

title: Iterate toward √2
label: Iteration
steps: Average the current guess with 2 divided by the guess.
note: Correction: the finite sixth term is close to √2, not exactly 1 as recorded.

title: Test before adding
label: Terms shown
steps: Terms grow and do not tend to zero.
The series diverges; a geometric sum to infinity needs |r|<1.
note: Correction: the source treats 7/4 as less than 1 and concludes convergence.

title: Slow decay, infinite total
label: Terms shown
steps: This is a p-series with p=3/5≤1.
It diverges, despite terms tending to zero.
note: The recorded divergence conclusion is correct; the exponent is 3/5, not the recorded 2/5.

title: Bound what remains
label: Cutoff N
steps: The terms come from a positive continuous decreasing function on [2,∞).
The corresponding improper integral is 1/ln2, so the series converges.
The omitted tail satisfies R_N≤1/ln N.
note: The displayed bound is for the omitted tail, not the full sum.

title: Watch cancellation
label: Terms shown
steps: The positive term magnitudes approach zero.
They decrease for n≥2, so the alternating-series test applies.
Their ratio to 1/√n approaches 1: absolute divergence gives conditional convergence.
note: For N≥2, the truncation error is at most the next term magnitude.

title: Build a function from pieces
label: Choose x
note: The partial polynomial is a new interactive reconstruction of the source expansion.

title: Balance a region
formula: y = eˣ  |  y = e⁻ˣ  |  0 ≤ x ≤ ln2
label: Sweep to x
note: The source area and centroid agree with recomputation.

title: Return to a complete curve
label: Angle θ
steps: Use x=r cos θ and y=r sin θ.
One complete trace uses θ from 0 to 2π.
note: A closing reconstruction of the polar work on take-home final page 5.
